hypothesis: Earlier source-only reviewer intake can accept structurally valid but semantically unscorable objects; a prospective typed annotation contract should reject those without modifying frozen evidence.
negative_control: A fictional source-only decision with valid record/source/archive metadata passes predecessor intake but fails v0.2 solely for missing statement; hosted integration assertion verifies the error list.
limitations: Existing v0.1 and v0.4 validators check structural references, not source meaning.
Typed fields are necessary but not sufficient for semantic agreement.
Manual elapsed time remains self-reported and unverified.
New schema is prospective; old frozen packet and evaluator remain untouched.
Test fixtures are fictional; no human reviewer submissions or employer records are published.
decision: No maturity change, release or merge. Retain draft until independent review and evidence-quality gate.
next_experiment: Two voluntary blinded independent annotations of frozen fictional packet, adjudicate labels before general extractor run, then fairly timed manual-note comparison.
kill_or_reframe: If unsupported records or correction burden exceed manual notes, narrow to provenance/lineage assistance.
